item.title: August 09, 2026 - The Power of love
item.description: Page 231. "We begin to see that God's love has been present all the time, just waiting for us to accept it." Just for Today: I accept the love of a Higher Power in my life. I am conscious of that Power's guidance and strength within me. Today, I claim it for my own.
